memberships.page_title: The Categorical Quotient of Bounded Cubic Frames

statement: For the quadratic cubic-frame family A=c+alpha c^2 and B=-2-4alpha c+beta c^2, the arcs alpha=t and beta=q t^2 have constant stable class q away from t=0 and specialize to the base class at t=0. Consequently no separated algebraic space can functorially classify the bare stable left-right orbit set while distinguishing these geometric classes.
title: The Bare Stable-Orbit Moduli Problem Is Nonseparated
